incident.what: A byte-identical copy of the h31 download (decor-barrel-tripo-h31-3f7a258f-source.glb, sha256 7c81e9944f64390d1f0581c29b0bbc26884cf396603cf629575c1a37c2443782) appeared at 11:31:50 in art/pipeline-candidates/ASSET-MEDUSA-001/tripo-rig-20260928-p16/source/. That directory belongs to another run. The file name had been typed into the Tripo export dialog by this task, and P1.6's run.json lists the file under foreign_files, noting that the Chrome Save dialog was occupied by another download
incident.likely_mechanism: This task's h31 Save-As was left open in the shared Chrome. It was then finished from P1.6's session into P1.6's directory, and Chrome moved the .tmp there under the given name. The P1 review rated this as plausible but not proven. What happened to the other two .tmp files is not established

incident.rule_for_next_runs: One Tripo download at a time in a shared Chrome. Finish or cancel your own Save-As dialog before handing the browser over or ending the session
